title: Successive Convexification in Learned World Models for Safe Offline Planning
abstract: arXiv:2611.19466v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: World models learned from offline data allow an agent to plan without further interaction with the environment, but the sampling-based planners used with them handle safety constraints only by scoring or rejecting sampled action sequences. We instead pose safe planning in the latent space of a learned world model as a successive convex program (SCP), in which a learned discrete-time control barrier function is imposed as a constraint at every step of the horizon. SCP requires smooth dynamics, so we build the networks from smoothed MaxMin activations and spectrally normalised layers, and bound the resulting linearisation error in terms of the Lipschitz bound and the smoothing width. As SCP is a local method, we start it from a sampled plan. On two Safety-Gymnasium navigation tasks with offline data, this planner has fewer violations than MPPI and CEM drawing 128 times as many samples at equal wall-clock time in our main comparison, though

translated_title: 在学习世界模型中进行逐次凸化以实现安全离线规划
translated_abstract: 从离线数据中学习得到的世界模型使智能体无需与环境进一步交互即可进行规划，但与之配合使用的基于采样的规划器只能通过评分或拒绝采样得到的动作序列来处理安全约束。我们转而将在学习世界模型潜在空间中进行安全规划这一问题表述为逐次凸规划（SCP），其中在每个规划时域步上都施加学习得到的离散时间控制障碍函数作为约束。SCP 要求动力学是光滑的，因此我们使用平滑的 MaxMin 激活函数和谱归一化层来构建网络，并根据 Lipschitz 界和平滑宽度对由此产生的线性化误差进行了界定。由于 SCP 是一种局部方法，我们从采样得到的规划出发来启动它。在两个使用离线数据的 Safety-Gymnasium 导航任务上，在我们的主要对比实验中，该规划器在与 MPPI 和 CEM 相同的墙钟时间下，即使后者采样数量多达 128 倍，其安全违规次数也更少，尽管……
tldr: 该论文提出将学习世界模型潜在空间中的安全离线规划表述为逐次凸规划，以平滑MaxMin激活和谱归一化层构建光滑动力学并施加学习得到的离散时间控制障碍函数约束，在Safety-Gymnasium导航任务上以更少的安全违规超越了采样量多128倍的MPPI和CEM。
en_tdlr: This paper formulates safe offline planning in the latent space of learned world models as a successive convex program with learned discrete-time control barrier function constraints, using smoothed MaxMin activations and spectrally normalized layers to enable smooth dynamics, achieving fewer safety violations than MPPI and CEM with 128x more samples on Safety-Gymnasium navigation tasks.
